audit: 1.1 (2026-10-26): every row re-audited against the experiment's hypothesis, data and decision_detail, not its title (review finding P30-2); E004 and E002 gain MOM

E001.basis: hypothesis: rules that time or rotate between asset classes (ALLOC); title and method include dual momentum (MOM) and trend timing (TREND)

E002.basis: hypothesis: a 10-month SMA (TREND) or 12-month absolute-momentum filter (MOM, time-series momentum)

E004.basis: hypothesis: factor ETFs including momentum beat MSCI World (FACTOR); data: IWFM momentum ETF; decision: momentum chosen as the tilt (MOM). Review finding P30-2

E005.basis: hypothesis: buying short-term dips (RSI-2, down-day streaks) beats buy-and-hold

E006.basis: hypothesis: scaling the momentum sleeve (MOM) by inverse relative volatility (VOLMGMT)

E007.basis: hypothesis: momentum sleeve (MOM) moved to cash below a 10-month SMA (TREND)

E008.basis: hypothesis: US-open breakout day trading (INTRADAY) with 3x Nasdaq ETPs (LEVERAGE)

E009.basis: hypothesis: 3x Nasdaq ETP (LEVERAGE) held only above a moving average (TREND)

E011.basis: hypothesis: intraday gold rules flat at every close

E012.basis: hypothesis: round-the-clock intraday rules on gold and Nasdaq futures
